description: Audit the licence compatibility of your entire dependency list. Input package names (with ecosystem) or SPDX IDs; get a COMPATIBLE/CONFLICT verdict with specific conflicting pairs and recommended action. Uses static SPDX compatibility table — no network call for spdx_ids path. Package path resolves licences from deps.dev (max 10 concurrent). Max 50 items. Rate limit: 60/minute. No auth required. For developers and compliance teams auditing open source licence risk before shipping. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="security_audit_licence_compatibility", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".

packages.description: List of {name, ecosystem} dicts to check compatibility. Optional.

spdx_ids.description: List of SPDX licence identifiers to check compatibility. Optional.

name: security_audit_licence_compatibility
title: Security Audit Licence Compatibility
